narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the US-Iran conflict escalates beyond a one-off exchange, with Iran shooting down a US Apache and threatening Hormuz. Simultaneous Ukraine deep strikes and Israel's two-front war compound the risk premium, driving equity selloffs and commodity spikes.
narratives.trade_implication: Long crude oil and gold; short S&P 500 and emerging market equities; consider long volatility via VIX futures.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Structural Shift
narratives.summary: The EIA's extended Hormuz blockade timeline through Q3 2026 is forcing structural capital flows into energy infrastructure bypass plays, like Kuwait's pipeline talks with Saudi/UAE. Oil prices are being repriced higher, with WTI forecast at $88.32, as supply disruption becomes entrenched.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and energy infrastructure ETFs (e.g., pipeline operators); short consumer discretionary and airlines.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Divergence
narratives.summary: Despite BTC's macro-driven selloff, capital is flowing into crypto via institutional channels, as evidenced by Janus Henderson's $300B+ partnership with Ethena for tokenized CLOs. This decoupling from retail risk-off sentiment suggests selective bullishness on blockchain-based real-world assets.
narratives.trade_implication: Long tokenized asset protocols (e.g., ENA) and BTC via institutional-grade custodians; short leveraged retail crypto ETFs.
